meta.title: Sarana – help street animals
meta.description: See a dog or cat in trouble? Take a photo, add the location and post it. Volunteers nearby will help.

home.title: The next Brownie might be on your street.
home.subtitle: All it takes is a photo and a location. The community does the rest.

how.title: Three taps from a street corner to a helping hand.

s1.title: Take a photo
s1.body: Press the camera button and snap the animal. No app to download.

s2.title: Drop a pin
s2.body: Use your GPS or tap the map to mark exactly where the animal is.

s3.title: Help arrives
s3.body: Volunteers nearby see it at once: food, vet care, a lift, or a foster home.

stats.title: What the community has done so far

story.alt: A woman stops for a street dog in the rain, reports it, comes back to feed it, and finally gives it a home
story.dogLabel: Brownie the dog. Press to make him bark.

s1.title: 11 pm. Rain. Nobody stops.
s1.body: People hurry past under their umbrellas. He is still watching, hoping someone will stop. One ear has drooped.

s2.title: All she had was a phone.
s2.body: She took a photo. She didn't have to download an app. She opened the website and pressed the camera button.

s3.title: A pin. Now everyone can see.
s3.body: The location landed on the map. Volunteers nearby were notified right away.

s4.title: For the first time, someone came close.
s4.body: A volunteer nearby saw the notification and came with a bowl of food. A gentle hand stroked his head, and the drooping ear slowly lifted.

s5.title: Now he has a name. Brownie.
s5.body: The same person who stopped that rainy night finally gave him a home. Both ears are up now.
